title: Particle Analysis Method Using Multi-Segmented BED Signals for SEM
content: In this study, we describe a particle analysis method that combines scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS). SEM is used to observe the morphology of a sample surface with high resolution, and EDS is used to perform elemental analysis. Using this method, particle analysis can evaluate the shape and size distribution of fine particles with high accuracy, and quantitatively analyze their elemental compositions at the same time. This method is widely used in quality control, environmental analysis, foreign matter inspection, etc. Recently, the ability to process large amounts of data in a short time is required in the fields of manufacturing and environmental monitoring, so there is a growing demand for highly accurate and more efficient data analysis method.
